$comment: Minimal reproducers found by the differential fuzzer (tools/fuzz) and the world simulator (tools/sim). Blocks are made and signed by the spec-only oracle. `by` says how `expect` is read: first_code (the first refusal), includes_code, codes (exactly these, in order), subset (every key of expect matches), exact.

vectors.name: a block with no type is not canonical (not type_name)
refs.author as a set is a grammar error, not a block that passes unchecked
a genesis whose kind is an object is refused
an accept by someone who is not a side of the deal is not_a_side
only the author stops an open offer: a stop by anyone else is not_a_side
the stranger's stop does not stop the offer in the fold
a transfer whose money is a bare number has no shape
a thing whose pack is a bare number has no shape
an actor with no author and no key is a malformed genesis
a block sees the sm3: block it names
the old key speaks while the counted_to block of its rotation has not arrived
a device key brought in by a key that was itself brought in by a recovery rotation speaks
a block at seq 2^53 - 1 makes a chain that is not ok, without a list of 9e15 gaps
a 70 KB string where an id belongs is refused
